name: Wanouchi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Wanouchi town emblem in white: an outlined ring with a pointed top enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Wanouchi, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 October 1955.

features.role: Wanouchi town emblem — an outlined ring with a pointed top enclosing a ring
